values.支撑环节；是否为瓶颈取决于具体路线: Supporting stage; whether it becomes a bottleneck depends on the specific route
values.产业演化推演；不是必然形成或盈利预测: Industry-evolution reasoning; not a forecast that it will form or be profitable
values.与生态整体利益可能权衡: May be traded off against overall ecological interest
values.兼具内在价值与实现作用: Both intrinsic value and an enabling role
values.非人类主体地位需另行论证: Status of non-human actors requires separate argument
values.不是人口或领土无限增长: Not unlimited population or territorial growth
values.贯穿各类目标的边界: A boundary across all goal types
values.文化既是结果，也支持协作: Culture is both an outcome and a support for cooperation
values.避免不可逆地封闭未来: Avoid irreversibly closing off the future
values.补充领域｜贯穿七个原始类别: Supplementary domain | spans all seven original categories
values.识别阈值、损害与恢复能力: Identify thresholds, harm and recovery capacity
values.群体身份可重叠，不重复计数: Group identities may overlap; no double counting
values.避免局部改善造成整体损害: Avoid local gains causing overall harm
values.价值相对稳定；路径持续纠错: Values are relatively stable; paths are continuously corrected
values.非无限授权；权利边界仍有效: Not unlimited authorization; rights boundaries still apply
values.不把最不利群体留在底线以下: Do not leave the worst-off below the floor
values.少量研究不等于现实紧迫任务: Small research efforts are not urgent present tasks
values.底线约束下比较新增投入的效果: Compare marginal returns under the floor constraint
values.约束所有 P 等级与政策行动: Constrains every priority level and policy action
values.主体：社区组织、居民、社会组织: Actors: community organizations, residents, civil society
values.主体：专业机构、企业与劳动者: Actors: professional institutions, firms and workers
values.主体：地方政府、运营机构与公众: Actors: local government, operators and the public
values.主体：公共机构、公众与全国性组织: Actors: public institutions, the public and national bodies
values.主体：国家、国际组织、科研与社会网络: Actors: states, international organizations, research and social networks
values.现实议题＋条件性扩展；多主体协商: Present issues plus conditional extension; multi-actor negotiation
values.未来主体与可行路径待验证: Future actors and viable paths remain unverified
values.高度推测；不预设集中统治: Highly speculative; no centralized rule assumed
values.哲学与基础研究；非现成行政层级: Philosophy and basic research; not an existing administrative level
values.依证据与处置窗口安排 P0—P2: P0–P2 set by evidence and the response window
values.不同过程；不等于精确生存截止日: Distinct processes; not an exact survival deadline
values.条件性收益；依赖地球的基地不等于备份: Conditional benefit; an Earth-dependent base is not a backup
values.假说与远景 P4；不按既成威胁配置: Hypothesis and long-range vision P4; not resourced as an established threat
values.现实压力；不把老年人视为危机本身: Present pressure; older people are not the crisis itself
values.P2；紧迫安全任务可升级: P2; urgent safety tasks may rise
values.基本保障 P1；紧迫伤害 P0: Basic protection P1; urgent harm P0
values.基本权利与濒失保护 P1；发展 P2: Basic rights and imminent-loss protection P1; development P2
values.韧性 P2；地外验证 P3；远景 P4: Resilience P2; off-world validation P3; long-range P4
values.基本服务 P1；机制研究 P2—P3: Basic services P1; mechanism research P2–P3
values.供能保障 P1；技术组合 P2—P3: Energy security P1; technology portfolio P2–P3
values.基本权益 P1；制度适应 P2: Basic entitlements P1; institutional adaptation P2
values.国家／跨国｜政府、国际组织、社会组织: National / transnational | governments, international organizations, civil society
values.家庭至国家｜公共部门、社区、照护组织: Household to national | public sector, communities, care organizations
values.组织／地方／国家｜企业、劳动者、政府: Organizations / local / national | firms, workers, government
values.地方／国家｜财政税务部门、公众: Local / national | finance and tax authorities, the public
values.社区至国家｜学校、医院、科研文化机构: Community to national | schools, hospitals, research and cultural institutions
values.个人至国家｜司法、执法、法律援助与公众: Individual to national | judiciary, law enforcement, legal aid and the public
values.社区／城市／区域｜交通部门、运营者: Community / city / region | transport authorities, operators
values.流域／国家／地球｜环境部门、企业、社区: Watershed / national / planetary | environmental agencies, firms, communities
values.家庭至跨国｜供给企业、公共部门、居民: Household to transnational | suppliers, public sector, residents
values.家庭／社区／城市｜住房规划部门、居民: Household / community / city | housing and planning agencies, residents
values.个人至文明｜创作者、学校、社区、文化机构: Individual to civilization | creators, schools, communities, cultural institutions
values.个人至跨国｜平台、研究者、监管者、公众: Individual to transnational | platforms, researchers, regulators, the public
values.地方至跨国｜公共机构、公众、社会组织: Local to transnational | public institutions, the public, civil society
values.国家／跨国／未来栖居地｜科研与治理主体: National / transnational / future habitats | research and governance actors
values.既有产业／公共能力需升级: Existing industry / public capacity needs upgrading
values.组合路线；按节点证据分阶段推进: Portfolio route; staged by node-level evidence
values.适应证分化；部分成熟、部分研发: Indications diverge; some mature, some in R&D
values.既有备份服务向韧性扩展: Existing backup services extending into resilience
values.质量、规模、专业人才与可替代供应；不以单一企业或来源为唯一保障。: Quality, scale, skilled people and substitutable supply; no single firm or source is the only safeguard.
values.定义基线、门槛、投入、退出条件和分配结果；不以远期价值替代现实证据。: Define baselines, thresholds, investment, exit conditions and distributional outcomes; long-range value must not replace present evidence.
values.跨环境验证、概率校准、失效可恢复: Cross-environment validation, probability calibration, recoverable failure
values.长期可靠运行、能源与零件保障: Long-term reliable operation, energy and spare-part supply
values.活性维持、寿命、控制与一致性: Viability maintenance, lifetime, control and consistency
values.功能可控、标准制造、体内外安全: Controllable function, standard manufacturing, in vitro and in vivo safety
values.功能稳定、污染控制、放大与追溯: Stable function, contamination control, scale-up and traceability
values.在实际环境中验证可靠性与清除: Validate reliability and clearance in real environments
values.读写成本、解码方法与设备可得性: Read/write cost, decoding methods and equipment availability
values.跨人群验证、真实结局关联与隐私: Cross-population validation, links to real outcomes and privacy
values.长期安全、真实获益与适用人群: Long-term safety, real benefit and eligible population
values.长期安全、组织特异性与功能证据: Long-term safety, tissue specificity and functional evidence
values.功能成熟、质量控制、长期安全与可及: Mature function, quality control, long-term safety and access
values.真实人群结果、可及性与服务质量: Real-world population outcomes, access and service quality
values.物理性能→整厂净电力→可靠性→成本: Physics performance → plant net electricity → reliability → cost
values.驱动效率、重复性、靶制造与整厂集成: Driver efficiency, repeatability, target manufacturing and plant integration
values.材料寿命、燃料可持续供给、可用率: Material lifetime, sustainable fuel supply, availability
values.可靠、经济、可维护的系统组合: A reliable, economic and maintainable system portfolio
values.性能、批量制造、寿命与全流程成本: Performance, mass manufacturing, lifetime and full-process cost
values.关键零件、原料和检验体系能否闭合: Whether critical parts, feedstock and inspection systems can close
values.长时稳定、物质平衡、微生物与故障控制: Long-term stability, mass balance, microbial and fault control
values.生态结果、持续性与群体影响: Ecological outcomes, durability and population effects
values.运输之外的完整生活与工业支持: Complete living and industrial support beyond transport
values.独立评估、真实事件反馈与责任清晰: Independent evaluation, real-incident feedback and clear accountability
values.能够读取、理解、验证并应用: Can be read, understood, verified and applied
values.资源效率、食品安全、成本与饮食接受: Resource efficiency, food safety, cost and dietary acceptance
values.终点有效、长期结果与公平可及；不能用时钟分数包装延寿承诺。: Valid endpoints, long-term outcomes and equitable access; clock scores must not be used to wrap longevity promises.
values.安全与真实健康获益通过验证后，才可扩展适应证或服务。: Expand indications or services only after safety and real health benefit are validated.
values.具体组织功能和适应证逐项验证；完整器官替换另需突破。: Validate specific tissue functions and indications one by one; whole-organ replacement needs separate breakthroughs.
values.长期稳定、神经数据保护、可退出和可负担。: Long-term stability, neural data protection, exitability and affordability.
values.按长期可用率和恢复表现交付，保留人工接管。: Deliver on long-term availability and recovery performance, retaining human takeover.
values.实验可重复、数据可信、用途与生物安全边界。: Reproducible experiments, trustworthy data, and boundaries for use and biosafety.
values.放大、产率、污染控制与全生命周期成本。: Scale-up, yield, contamination control and full life-cycle cost.
values.证明特定任务优势、可控性、批次一致性与安全。: Demonstrate task-specific advantage, controllability, batch consistency and safety.
values.临床或实际环境中的可靠效果；非普遍成熟疗法。: Reliable effects in clinical or real-world settings; not a generally mature therapy.
values.不同路线分别核验；可先形成部件与测试需求。: Verify each route separately; component and testing demand can form first.
values.整厂净发电、燃料可持续供给、可用率、成本及许可均需通过。: Plant net electricity, sustainable fuel supply, availability, cost and licensing must all pass.
values.只有交付能源的成本与可靠性合适才形成优势；不专属聚变。: An advantage exists only if delivered energy is affordable and reliable; not unique to fusion.
values.关键原料、工具、检验和零件链条能够持续维持。: Critical feedstock, tools, inspection and spare-part chains can be sustained.
values.长时稳定、损失补偿、故障隔离与真实补给依赖。: Long-term stability, loss compensation, fault isolation and actual resupply dependence.
values.需求、运输、资源条件、维修能力与空间规则共同成立。: Demand, transport, resource conditions, maintenance capability and space rules must all hold.
values.产品价值、运输经济性、安全和任务可靠性逐项验证。: Validate product value, transport economics, safety and mission reliability item by item.
values.数据可读、技能可传、设备可造；避免把档案等同完整文明。: Data readable, skills transferable, equipment buildable; an archive is not a whole civilization.
values.可信独立、证据可核查；风险分担依赖真实数据。: Credibly independent, verifiable evidence; risk sharing depends on real data.
values.根据实际健康、寿命与劳动变化调整，不能预设延寿一定减少照护成本。: Adjust to actual changes in health, lifespan and work; do not assume longevity lowers care costs.
values.以真实生态与社区结果评价，防止只优化易测代理指标。: Judge by real ecological and community outcomes; do not optimize only easily measured proxies.
values.需要技术、需求、成本、制度与主体接受共同成立。: Requires technology, demand, cost, institutions and actor acceptance to hold together.
values.降低单点风险需要物质、工业、知识与治理上的真实独立；分散地点仍可能共享软件、供应: Reducing single-point risk requires real material, industrial, knowledge and governance independence; dispersed sites may still share software, supply chains and institutional risks.
values.生物年龄时钟变化不能自动替代真实健康结局。: Changes in biological-age clocks cannot automatically replace real health outcomes.
values.动物延寿不等于人类延寿；不设无证据的寿命年数承诺。: Extended lifespan in animals does not mean extended human lifespan; no unsupported promises of added years.
values.若延寿收益高度集中，可能加剧财富、权力和机会差距。: If longevity gains are highly concentrated, wealth, power and opportunity gaps may widen.
values.聚变是候选路线之一；现有清洁能源、储能、电网与效率改进仍需投入。: Fusion is one candidate route; existing clean energy, storage, grids and efficiency improvements still need investment.
values.模型预测不能替代真实实验，也不能把单一模型当作唯一决策依据。: Model predictions cannot replace real experiments, and no single model should be the sole basis for decisions.
values.任务演示不等于长期自主；应评估运行时长、人工接管与恢复能力。: A task demo is not long-term autonomy; assess operating hours, human takeover and recovery.
values.沟通或光标控制证据不等于普遍读心、完整记忆转移或意识上传。: Evidence of communication or cursor control is not general mind reading, full memory transfer or mind uploading.
values.生物组织可能提供特定功能，但不自动优于机械系统。: Biological tissue may provide specific functions but is not automatically superior to mechanical systems.
values.局部实验行为不等于通用生物机器人；不预设意识或通用智能。: Local experimental behaviour is not a general biobot; no consciousness or general intelligence is assumed.
values.DNA 序列设计并不保证复杂生命行为可精确预测。: Designing DNA sequences does not guarantee that complex living behaviour can be precisely predicted.
values.DNA 装置不一定是生命，也不必涉及基因修改。: DNA devices are not necessarily alive and need not involve genetic modification.
values.保存数据不等于保存理解与重建能力，应采用多介质备份。: Storing data is not preserving understanding and the ability to rebuild; use multi-medium backups.
values.时钟分数降低不自动证明健康寿命或总寿命延长。: A lower clock score does not by itself prove longer healthspan or lifespan.
values.动物结果不能直接外推人类；衰老细胞存在有益作用，不能简单追求全部清除。: Animal results do not transfer directly to humans; senescent cells have beneficial roles, so total clearance is not a simple goal.
values.特定动物组织结果不等于全身返老还童；需关注细胞身份与肿瘤等风险。: Results in specific animal tissues are not whole-body rejuvenation; watch cell identity and tumour risks.
values.具体适应证证据不能泛化为全身抗衰或完整器官任意替换。: Evidence for specific indications cannot be generalized to whole-body anti-aging or arbitrary organ replacement.
values.已有医疗与公共卫生保障不应等待远期延寿突破。: Existing medical and public-health protection should not wait for distant longevity breakthroughs.
values.等离子体增益不等于电站净发电；不承诺商业化日期。: Plasma gain is not plant net electricity; no commercialization date is promised.
values.单次实验增益不能替代连续电站的能量与成本核算。: A single-shot experimental gain cannot replace continuous plant energy and cost accounting.
values.不同路线依赖不同；氘氚路线尤其要验证燃料自持与管理。: Routes have different dependencies; the deuterium–tritium route especially must prove fuel self-sufficiency and handling.
values.聚变进展不应成为延迟现实清洁供能和效率改进的理由。: Fusion progress must not become a reason to delay real clean-energy deployment and efficiency improvements.
values.材料性能提升需同时核算制造、维护和环境代价。: Material performance gains must be accounted together with manufacturing, maintenance and environmental costs.
values.单项制氧或加工演示不等于自主工业体系。: A single oxygen-generation or processing demo is not an autonomous industrial system.
values.物质循环仍需能源并存在损失；不预设完全封闭或永久自给。: Material cycles still need energy and lose material; neither full closure nor permanent self-sufficiency is assumed.
values.资源开发和修复工程需评估全生命周期影响。: Resource development and restoration works need full life-cycle impact assessment.
values.到达另一星球不等于能够独立延续文明。: Reaching another planet is not independently sustaining a civilization.
values.性能与安全要同时检验；统一系统可能带来相关失效。: Performance and safety must be tested together; unified systems can fail in correlated ways.
values.只保存数据不足以保证灾后重建；需要人、组织与工业工具。: Storing data alone cannot ensure post-disaster rebuilding; people, organizations and industrial tools are needed.
values.粮食安全不能只依赖单一作物、菌株、设备或供应商。: Food security cannot rest on a single crop, strain, facility or supplier.
values.无失能生存、疾病负担、生活质量、功能维持；按群体分层。: Disability-free survival, disease burden, quality of life and functional maintenance; stratified by group.
values.长期生存与不良事件；区分平均寿命、健康寿命和极端寿命。: Long-term survival and adverse events; distinguish average lifespan, healthspan and extreme longevity.
values.独立生活、照护负担、可负担性、群体差距、参与机会。: Independent living, care burden, affordability, group gaps and participation opportunities.
values.交付电力、可靠性、全系统成本、生命周期环境影响。: Delivered electricity, reliability, whole-system cost and life-cycle environmental impact.

values.title: L1 · Ultimate values
values.note: Parallel values; human well-being is the main thread, with no single total score

outcomes.title: L2 · Basic outcomes
outcomes.note: Survival, living, dignity, meaning and future opportunity

strategies.title: L3 · Civilizational strategies
strategies.note: The seven original strategies keep multiple affiliations

domains.title: L4–L5 · Governance domains and sub-goals
domains.note: O1–O7 are the original game categories; X1–X7 are supplementary domains

subgoals.title: L5 · Added health and energy goals
subgoals.note: Healthspan, total lifespan, actor autonomy and reliable energy are assessed separately

crises.title: Crises and demands
crises.note: Present pressures, systemic risks and hypothetical scenarios are handled separately

capabilities.title: Enabling capabilities
capabilities.note: Connect technology to goals; capability alone does not equal well-being

technologies.title: Key technology directions
technologies.note: Maturity is judged per application; priority is not technological sophistication

industries.title: Supporting industries and public capacity
industries.note: Components, services, talent, validation, capital and institutions all support

emerging.title: Industry evolution directions
emerging.note: Upgrades of existing industries, growth directions and conditional long-range visions are labelled separately

missions.title: Six portfolio routes
missions.note: Observe industrial dependence, goal contribution and side effects at once

actions.title: L6 · Policy and action
actions.note: Resources, actors, deadlines and staged exit conditions

feedback.title: L7 · Metrics and feedback
feedback.note: Real outcomes, distribution, cost and evidence updates

priority.title: Cross-layer · Dynamic priorities and constraints
priority.note: P0–P4 arrange action; rights and fairness run through the whole map

scales.title: Orthogonal · Scale, scope and actors
scales.note: Scale is not a value hierarchy; responsibility matches resources and capability

horizon.title: Long-term survival and conditional boundaries
horizon.note: Solar evolution, multi-site habitation and alien scenarios keep their original distinctions

all.title: Everything
all.description: The complete network of values, goals, crises, technologies, industries, actions, feedback and scales.

aging.title: Healthspan and delaying ageing
aging.description: From health and autonomy needs, trace measurement, mechanistic intervention, clinical manufacturing and long-lived-society services; animal and biomarker evidence does not directly equal human lifespan extension.

fusion.title: Controllable fusion and the energy industry
fusion.description: Component and validation industries can move first; fusion power and heat must pass net-electricity, fuel, materials, availability and cost gates. Other clean supply paths proceed in parallel.

ai-bio.title: AI, brain–computer interfaces and biotechnology
ai-bio.description: AI, embodied intelligence, brain–computer interfaces and biotechnology are composable capabilities, not one inevitable sequence of technological progress.

habitat.title: Earth habitability and off-world habitation
habitat.description: The value of migration and dispersion depends on continuous energy, life support, industrial maintenance and cooperation; reaching another planet is not forming an independent civilization.

recovery.title: Civilizational recovery and unknown crises
recovery.description: Preserve data, skills, reading methods and rebuildable production; alien invasion appears only as an unconfirmed conditional scenario.

industry.title: Technology and industry evolution
industry.description: Supporting industries provide inputs; technologies improve services and industrial upgrading; new industries must satisfy technology, demand, cost and institutional conditions at once.

original.title: Original values and governance frame
original.description: Retains all 60 original nodes and 185 relations; technologies and industries are added as an implementation dimension connected to them.

age-itp.title: NIA: Interventions Testing Program (mice)
age-itp.note: The subjects are mice; human lifespan extension cannot be inferred directly.

age-sennet.title: NIH SenNet: roles of cellular senescence and translation challenges
age-sennet.note: Senescent cells have context-dependent beneficial and harmful roles; human translation needs validation.

age-biomarker.title: NIA: ageing proteomics and biomarker research
age-biomarker.note: Biomarker research informs mechanisms, risk and interventions; it is not a validated surrogate endpoint for lifespan.

age-reprogram.title: Nature 2020: reprogramming in mouse retina
age-reprogram.note: Results in a specific tissue and animal model are not evidence of whole-body human rejuvenation.

fusion-iter.title: ITER: scientific and engineering challenges of fusion energy
fusion-iter.note: Superconductors, vacuum, cryogenics, materials, heat exhaust, maintenance and the fuel cycle require system integration.

fusion-gaps.title: ITER: gaps still to close on the way to a fusion plant
fusion-gaps.note: Fuel self-sufficiency, reliability, materials and high availability are plant-level challenges.

fusion-electric.title: ITER: from neutron energy to electricity
fusion-electric.note: ITER does not generate electricity itself; experimental gain and plant net electricity must be distinguished.

ai-af3.title: Nature 2024: AlphaFold 3
ai-af3.note: Supports structure prediction for specific biomolecules; it cannot replace experimental and clinical validation.

ai-weather.title: Nature 2024: probabilistic weather forecasting
ai-weather.note: Demonstrates probabilistic forecasting capability; generalization across environments still needs testing.

bci.title: Nature Medicine 2026: long-term independent use of a brain–computer interface
bci.note: Communication and cursor control in individual studies are not general mind reading or mind uploading.

biobot.title: PNAS 2020: computationally designed living constructs
biobot.note: Experimental validation of specific cellular constructs and behaviours; general application still requires research.

dna-switch.title: Nature 2000: synthetic genetic switches
dna-switch.note: Specific gene circuits can achieve regulatory functions; this does not mean all of life can be programmed at will.

dna-nano.title: Science 2012: logic-responsive DNA molecular devices
dna-nano.note: Proof of concept; it cannot be extrapolated directly into a mature clinical therapy.

dna-store.title: Scientific Reports 2019: automated DNA data storage
dna-store.note: The experimental system validated writing, storage and reading; scale, cost and readability still matter.

space-bio.title: NASA: bioengineering and life support
space-bio.note: Covers air, water, waste and biomanufacturing; it does not represent a fully self-sufficient off-world ecosystem.

moxie.title: NASA: the MOXIE Mars oxygen experiment
moxie.note: Validates one in-situ resource utilisation technology; it does not represent a complete industrial loop.

robotics.title: NASA: autonomous systems and robotics
robotics.note: Practical uses and directions for robotic exploration and autonomous operation.

ai-risk.title: NIST: AI risk management framework
ai-risk.note: Trustworthiness must span design, use, evaluation and governance.

sun.title: NASA: solar evolution
sun.note: The Sun becomes a red giant in about five billion years, distinct from earlier habitability changes.

oxygen.title: Nature Geoscience 2021: model of Earth's oxygen-rich atmosphere lifetime
oxygen.note: A billion-year-scale model result, not a precise deadline for human survival.

alien.title: NASA: statement on extraterrestrial life and UAP evidence
alien.note: No alien civilization invasion threat is confirmed; related routes are conditional scenarios.
